result.title: TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback
result.summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) typically applies a shared scale to all latent tokens, although their velocity predictions evolve differently during sampling. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (TrajCFG), a training-free method for flow-matching models that adapts token-wise guidance using historical changes in guided velocity direction. TrajCFG maps this feedback to bounded scales, assigning stronger guidance to larger directional changes and weaker guidance to more consistent directions. It combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span feedback, reusing standard CFG predictions without additional model evaluations. Controlled diagnostics and ablations examine the roles of directional feedback, token-wise allocation, and history-span fusion. Experiments on text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation show improvements over base samplers across multiple backbones. For text-to-video generation, TrajCFG improves VBench Total scores by 0.30-0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones. These results support historical directional feedback as a broadly applicable signal for fine-grained guidance allocation. The project page is available at https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 TrajCFG：在 flow-matching 采样中依据引导速度方向的历史变化，为每个 latent token 分配有界且自适应的 CFG 强度。方法复用标准 CFG 预测、不增加模型调用，并通过消融与文本到视频、图像、音频视频、3D 等生成任务验证其有效性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按 token 依据轨迹历史反馈动态分配引导强度」的机制，可能与 LVR 中随推理步动态分配计算或引导、逐 token 更新状态的设计相通，可供核查；但论文面向生成采样而非多模态推理，联系需较多验证。
